environment.description: AWS Lambda function URL with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy specifies a Condition block requiring aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the organization ID (o-a1b2c3d4e5) and restricts the principal to a specific IAM role ARN (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/iot-ingestion-service-role) via aws:PrincipalArn condition key. The function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 with body '{"Message":"Forbidden"}' for any request lacking a valid SigV4 signature from the authorized principal. Note: the underlying binary still contains the double-free; however, the attack surface requires authenticated access. The IAM role's trust policy only allows sts:AssumeRole from a specific EC2 instance profile in a private subnet with no internet gateway. CloudTrail data events are enabled for Lambda invoke actions.
